label: Women's ODI
methodology: The 100 most recent eligible international matches in the downloaded archive. First innings only, replayed at completed-over checkpoints using only deliveries available at that checkpoint. Full-length six-ball-over matches, including all-out innings that reached all checkpoints; rain-adjusted and no-result matches excluded. Historical replay of the current model, not an out-of-time training holdout. Existing model priors and learned adjustments may incorporate historical information. Eligibility favours longer innings; this is not a random sample of all matches. ODI model revisions were evaluated against this same cohort; these are calibration results, not a held-out evaluation. Women's fixtures now use the women's fielding rating keys.
summary: Across 400 predictions the model has an MAE of 38.3 runs and RMSE of 51.9 runs. Bias is +7.8 runs (the model overshoots on average). Final-wicket MAE is 2.99 wickets, with a signed bias of -2.90 wickets (predicted minus actual). Exact final-wicket counts occur in 8.5% of checkpoint predictions. The predicted range captures the actual score 51.7% of the time with an average range width of 66 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 48.8 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 21.3 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 40.8 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 10-over checkpoint (MAE 51.3 runs) and most accurate at 40 overs (MAE 25.0 runs).
